info.description: Trusted-network application with no app login, cookies or bearer tokens. Native requests without Origin are supported. Browser API requests must match the configured public origin (or HTTP Host origin); cross-site fetches are rejected. All identifiers are canonical lowercase UUIDs; account/transaction identities are budget-scoped. Unknown JSON fields are rejected.

get.description: Bounded account/all-account register. JSON query validates up to 20 AND/OR conditions; account, as_of and visibility intersect the result. Sorting has stable date/creation/identity ties. balances covers full scope, filtered_balances/count all matching history; running_balance is chronological full-scope balance independent of filtering/sorting. Exact integer aggregates stream on server; only the bounded page is downloaded. Continue using same query and snapshot; 409 register_changed requires starting over. No snapshot means no consistency guarantee. Patterns use ECMAScript non-u UTF-16 code-unit semantics. Compilation permits 2048 UTF-16 units, 64 nested groups and 256 structural tokens, with optimizer expansion disabled. Matching permits 20000 input code units and 10 interruption quanta of 1024 VM instructions, backtracker/loop steps and precharged backreference comparison units per invocation. Every invocation charges 1024 plus pattern/input code units against a shared 67108864-work-unit request budget; each additional interruption quantum charges 1024. Exceeding limits returns HTTP400 regex_complexity_limit or regex_work_limit, never partial rows/totals. Invalid syntax returns invalid_regex. Narrow account/date scope or simplify the pattern before retrying. Recurring date filters inspect first 100 occurrences, matching Actual 26.10 conditionsToAQL; weekend posting adjustments do not alter filter dates. Unfiltered newest-first reads retain cached financial totals and indexed row retrieval; count uses an index scan, later pages sum only preceding amounts. Filtered totals and arbitrary sorting may scan the selected scope. Search also recognizes absolute amounts and dates in the budget date format.
